claims.statement: Clone feature declares FPT/GHEC and GHES>3.18. Original must be open, triage required at source and destination and destination must allow blank issues; cloning is not transfer.

Clone prefills title/description/assignees/type/labels/milestones/Projects only where available at destination. Labels match name; milestones name and due date. Original remains unchanged; no claim that comments/history or all field values are copied.
Mentions receive no cloning notification; new issue has distinct URL and details can be edited before creation. Missing triage suppresses option, not evidence of universally unavailable feature.

Deletion declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and permanent removal. Personal repository deletion is limited to owning account; organization repository requires admin/owner and owner-enabled organization issue-deletion setting.

Collaborators receive no deletion notification. Deleted URL shows not-found, API can identify deletion and admin/owner additionally sees deleting actor/time. Ordinary not-found alone cannot prove deletion versus inaccessible data.
UI requires deletion confirmation; procedure is source evidence not authorization. No restoration guarantee is supplied; recovery/export and exact target approval needed before destructive use.
Transfer declares FPT/GHEC/GHES; open issue and write at both repositories required. Both repositories must share same user/organization owner; private-to-public transfer is forbidden.
Transfer retains comments/assignees; labels require name match and milestones name plus due date at destination. Other metadata preservation is not guaranteed by this passage.

Mentions receive transfer notification; original URL redirects, and users without destination read access see inaccessible-transfer banner. Redirect identity does not grant access or establish full data preservation.

CLI transfer uses exact issue number/URL and destination owner/repo; GHES conditional includes hostname/URL variant. Actual version compatibility, permissions, successful readback and recovery remain unverified; example not executed.
